# Cloud Cache Action

> High-performance, drop-in GitHub Action for saving and restoring CI cache bundles directly to any S3-compatible cloud or self-hosted object storage with 1:1 actions/cache parity and native Node 24 runtime.

Author: Yurii Serhiichuk (https://serhiichuk.dev)
Repository: https://github.com/xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action
Documentation: https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/
License: MIT

## Overview

Cloud Cache Action is designed to solve GitHub Actions cache limits (10 GB default per repository) and egress transfer fees by letting developers store cache archives in their own S3-compatible storage tier (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Storage, Backblaze B2, Fastly Object Storage, Garage S3, SeaweedFS, MinIO).

It provides:
- 1:1 input and output compatibility with `actions/cache` (v4, v5, and v6).
- Native Node 24 execution (`runs: using: 'node24'`) with zero runner deprecation warnings.
- Multi-threaded Zstandard (`zstd`) compression with automatic `gzip` fallback.
- Dual-caching mode: syncs simultaneously to both remote S3 and GitHub Actions Cache tier for maximum resilience.
- Standalone sub-actions: `xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action/restore@v1` and `xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action/save@v1`.
- Safe POSIX key normalization: Guarantees forward slashes (`/`) in S3 keys across Windows, Linux, and macOS runners.

## Quickstart

```yaml
- name: Cache dependencies to S3
  uses: xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action@v1
  with:
    bucket: my-ci-cache-bucket
    endpoint: https://<account_id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com # Or AWS, GCS, B2, MinIO
    access-key: ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY }}
    secret-key: ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_KEY }}
    path: |
      ~/.npm
      node_modules
    key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: |
      ${{ runner.os }}-node-
```

## Inputs Reference

### Standard `actions/cache` Inputs
- `path` (required): Files, directories, or wildcard patterns to cache and restore.
- `key` (required): Primary key for restoring and saving the cache.
- `restore-keys` (optional): Ordered multiline prefix keys evaluated if primary key misses.
- `fail-on-cache-miss` (optional, default: false): Fails the workflow if no cache match is found.
- `lookup-only` (optional, default: false): Checks if a cache entry exists without downloading.
- `read-only` (optional, default: false): Restores cache but skips saving in the post step.
- `save-always` (optional, default: false): Saves cache even if preceding steps failed.
- `enableCrossOsArchive` (optional, default: false): Enables Windows runners to share archives across platforms.

### S3 & Cloud Storage Inputs
- `bucket` (required): S3 bucket name.
- `endpoint` (optional): S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. `https://storage.googleapis.com` or `https://<id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`).
- `region` (optional, default: 'auto' / 'us-east-1'): Storage region.
- `provider` (optional): Provider preset: `aws`, `r2`, `gcs`, `b2`, `fastly`, `garage`, `seaweedfs`, `minio`.
- `access-key` / `accessKey` (optional): S3 Access Key ID (defaults to AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or IAM/OIDC).
- `secret-key` / `secretKey` (optional): S3 Secret Access Key (defaults to AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY).
- `session-token` / `sessionToken` (optional): S3 Session Token (defaults to AWS_SESSION_TOKEN).
- `force-path-style` (optional): Force path-style addressing (auto-configured for MinIO and GCS).
- `prefix` (optional, default: ''): Subfolder prefix inside the bucket.
- `s3-key-pattern` (optional, default: `${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/${prefix}${key}/${archive_filename}`): S3 key structure template. Supports `${RUNNER_OS}`, `${GITHUB_JOB}`, etc.
- `scoped-to-repository` (optional, default: true): Prefixes bucket keys with repository name.
- `retry` (optional, default: true): Exponential backoff retries on transient errors.
- `retry-count` (optional, default: 3): Number of retry attempts.
- `use-fallback` (optional, default: false): Fallback to GitHub Actions Cache service on miss/error.

### Dual-Caching Inputs
- `dual-cache` (optional, default: false): Simultaneously cache to both S3 and GitHub Actions Cache.
- `restore-priority` (optional, default: 's3-first'): Query priority: `s3-first` or `github-first`.
- `dual-cache-strategy` (optional, default: 'backfill'): Save strategy: `backfill`, `independent`, or `skip-on-hit`.
- `dual-cache-strict` (optional, default: false): Fails step if either tier errors (default false is fault-tolerant).

## Outputs Reference
- `cache-hit`: 'true' if exact match found for primary key; 'false' otherwise.
- `cache-primary-key`: Evaluated primary key.
- `cache-matched-key`: Restored key (primary or partial prefix match).
- `cache-size`: Archive size in bytes.
- `cache-storage-provider`: Resolved provider identifier (`aws`, `r2`, `gcs`, etc.).
- `cache-s3-key`: Full S3 object key inside the bucket.
- `cache-etag`: ETag checksum of archive in S3.
- `cache-hit-source`: Tier that serviced restore: `s3`, `github`, or `none`.
- `cache-saved-sources`: Tiers successfully saved to: `s3`, `github`, or `s3,github`.

## Provider Setups & Documentation Links

- [AWS S3](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/aws-s3.html): IAM static credentials or GitHub OIDC role assumption.
- [Cloudflare R2](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/cloudflare-r2.html): Zero egress fees object caching.
- [Google Cloud Storage](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/google-cloud-storage.html): XML API interoperability via HMAC service account keys.
- [Backblaze B2](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/backblaze-b2.html): High affordability S3 storage.
- [Fastly Object Storage](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/fastly-storage.html): Edge-proximate object storage.
- [Garage S3](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/garage.html): Lightweight distributed self-hosted storage.
- [SeaweedFS S3](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/providers/seaweedfs.html): High-capacity distributed filesystem with S3 gateway.
- [Dual-Caching Guide](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/guide/dual-caching.html): Multi-tier synchronization strategies.
- [S3 Key Patterns](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/guide/s3-key-patterns.html): Templating and organization-wide cache sharing.
- [Migration Guide](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/guide/migration.html): 2-minute migration from actions/cache or tespkg/actions-cache.
- [Full Documentation Concatenation](https://xsavikx.github.io/cloud-cache-action/llms-full.txt): Complete docs in single plain-text format.
